#### Determine if an object is a [`Buffer`](http://example.invalid/api/buffer.html) (including the [browserify Buffer](https://example.invalid/feross/buffer))

[![saucelabs][saucelabs-image]][saucelabs-url]

[saucelabs-image]: https://example.invalid/browser-matrix/is-buffer.svg
[saucelabs-url]: https://example.invalid/u/is-buffer

## Why not use `Buffer.isBuffer`?

This module lets you check if an object is a `Buffer` without using `Buffer.isBuffer` (which includes the whole [buffer](https://example.invalid/feross/buffer) module in [browserify](http://example.invalid/)).

It's future-proof and works in node too!

## install

```bash
npm install is-buffer
```

## usage

```js
var isBuffer = require('is-buffer')

isBuffer(new Buffer(4)) // true

isBuffer(undefined) // false
isBuffer(null) // false
isBuffer('') // false
isBuffer(true) // false
isBuffer(false) // false
isBuffer(0) // false
isBuffer(1) // false
isBuffer(1.0) // false
isBuffer('string') // false
isBuffer({}) // false
isBuffer(function foo () {}) // false
```
